_guide.what_is_this: Every word, link and list on the website lives in this file. Edit the values (the text in quotes on the right-hand side), save, and refresh the page.
_guide.do_not_change: Do not rename the keys (the words on the left of each colon) and keep every comma, quote and bracket in place.
_guide.highlighted_words: In headings, wrap words in **double stars** for bold and *single stars* for the highlighted italic style.
_guide.adding_items: To add a service, plan, FAQ or step: copy one complete { ... } block inside its list, paste it after a comma, and edit the text.
_guide.icons: Service icons use the names listed under "icons" below.
_guide.preview: This file is loaded by script.js, so preview the site through a local server (run `npm start`), not by double-clicking index.html.
